summary: Berkeley City Auditor Jenny Wong participated in a JCRC-funded trip to Israel in March 2023, appearing in a group photo at the Knesset, which was largely undisclosed to the public.
quote: barely visible in the background of a group photo of the JCRC's guests at Israel's Knesset on March 22, 2023, appeared a less familiar face: that of progressive darling Jenny Wong, first elected as Berkeley City Auditor in 2018
